description: This line plot illustrates the average repetition rate across 64 relation categories for three different experimental configurations: “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” (orange line with triangle markers), “DPO” (green line with square markers), and an unlabeled blue line with circle markers (likely representing a baseline or control condition). The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” spans integer values from 0 to 64, indicating discrete relation types. The y-axis, labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.6 on a linear scale, with major gridlines at intervals of 0.1. The orange line exhibits high variability, peaking sharply at category 32 (≈0.6) and showing multiple local maxima, with an overall average (dashed orange line) of 0.227. The green “DPO” line remains relatively low and stable, mostly below 0.2, with an average (dashed green line) of 0.117. The blue line fluctuates more than the green but less than the orange, with an average (dashed blue line) of 0.163. All three average lines are shown as dashed horizontal lines, indicating the mean repetition rate across all categories for each method. The plot visually demonstrates that the DPO method consistently yields the lowest repetition rate, suggesting greater diversity in generated training samples compared to the other configurations.
